faq.question: What should couples prepare before the first call?
faq.answer: Share the date, city, guest count, venue status, rough budget, and the planning decisions that feel most unclear.

faq.question: Is wedding-week coordination enough?
faq.answer: It works when the couple has already booked most vendors and needs execution support. Partial or full planning is better when vendor selection, budget, or design direction is still open.

faq.question: Can this become a real planner CRM?
faq.answer: Yes. P2-11 can move proposal inquiries into FastAPI/PostgreSQL, then Admin Console can manage statuses, notes, vendor touchpoints, and follow-up.
